Sillunu Oru Kadhal Tamil movie, New York Nagaram full HD video song featuring Suriya, Jyothika and Bhumika on Star Music India. Music by AR Rahman, directed by N. Krishna and produced by K. E. Gnanavel Raja.
Sillunu Oru Kadhal Tamil movie also stars Sukanya, Vadivelu, Santhanam and Thambi Ramaiah among others.
Song : New York Nagaram
Singers : Shreya Ghoshal, Naresh Iyer
Music : AR Rahman
